description.en: Coastal cities reduced by force (Tyre, Gaza); the interior (incl. Judea under its high priest) submitted and was left largely undisturbed.
description.ar: مدن ساحلية أُخضعت بالقوة (صور، غزة)؛ أما الداخل (بما فيه اليهودية تحت كاهنها الأعلى) فخضع وتُرك إلى حد كبير دون إزعاج.
description.he: ערי חוף הוכנעו בכוח (צור, עזה); הפנים (כולל יהודה תחת כוהנה הגדול) נכנע ונותר ברובו בלי הפרעה.

sources.quote: The storming of Tyre in July 332 was Alexander’s greatest military achievement
He left the Jews undisturbed in their religion and customs.
had already yielded to him; but a certain eunuch, named Batis, who was in possession of the city of Gaza, paid no heed to him
So Tyre had undergone the siege bravely rather than wisely and come into such misfortunes, after a resistance of seven months.
Alexander, in the meantime, marched down to Gaza, which was garrisoned by the Persians, and took the city by storm after a siege of two months.

notes.en: Extent of direct control inland is not described in the sources; interior units marked partial.
notes.ar: لا تصف المصادر امتداد السيطرة المباشرة في الداخل؛ ووُسمت وحدات الداخل بأنها جزئية.
notes.he: המקורות אינם מתארים את היקף השליטה הישירה בפנים הארץ; יחידות הפנים סומנו כחלקיות.
